text:
alex_irwin: Quick FYI — opened PR #4823 to refactor some legacy terraform modules (networking/* -> modules/net/) and rename a few module blocks. Need a quick check on provider pinning + .terraform.lock.hcl handling before we merge. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/4823
meera: Nice, thanks for the heads up. Does this touch state or just the module sources and locals?
sam: If it's just a code reorg and module rename, watch out for implicit provider inheritance changes — those bite during plan.
alex_irwin: No state move. I hoisted a required_providers block to the repo root because child modules relied on implicit provider constraints. Had to pin aws to avoid registry mismatch in staging.
meera: Can you paste the snippet you added?
alex_irwin: ```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 4.50"
    }
  }
}
```
sam: That looks fine. Two checks: 1) Ensure none of the submodules define a conflicting provider alias. 2) Update the .terraform.lock.hcl from a clean init so CI for prod doesn't reject it.
elaine: We had a staging plan fail earlier with "Incompatible provider version" — which modules were pinned differently?
alex_irwin: The failure happened because some modules pulled 4.38 constraints from older refs. Pinning at root fixed plan locally, but the lockfile changed checksums. CI in Dedicated infra pins the lockfile, so the CI job will fail until we commit the updated lockfile.
meera: For the lockfile update, run: `terraform init -backend=false && terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` in a clean workspace, commit .terraform.lock.hcl. Also add a short PR note: "Updated lockfile for aws ~>4.50".
sam: And mention the terraform version you used. We've had subtle provider selection differences across tfe versions.
alex_irwin: Using tfenv 1.5.6 locally. I added a note in PR body. I also left a compatibility shim in modules/net/README so consumers won't need to change module source references immediately.
meera: LGTM on the changes from a config perspective. One tiny ask: add a migration step in the PR checklist that calls out: run `terraform init -upgrade` in staging and re-run plan in a disposable workspace.
elaine: I'll queue a staging apply after merge and watch for any provider drift. @infra-bot can you tag release-ops when this merges?
infra-bot: @release-ops tagged by rule: terraform-mods-updates
alex_irwin: Thanks everyone — updating the PR with lockfile steps and terraform version. Will ping here if CI flips. :thumbsup:
